context:
Goal: an open panel reads cleanly over the list behind it.
Problem (rule): on 2026-10-11 an orchestrator set the default that an overlay panel takes the paper fill. You never confirmed or overruled it, and it was never built: panelWrap in src/app.jsx has padding and a top border, and no background. Whether the square edges look right with the fill is unmeasured.
Based on (read): src/app.jsx:1713-1716 panelWrap.
Based on (record): decision ruled-head-panels-carry-no-fill says you should check it on a screen.
Departs from: main panelWrap has no background — option a adds the paper fill.
Meanwhile: panels ship with no fill.

options.gain: An open panel stands apart from the list behind it.
options.how: Overlay panels get the paper background, then a screen check shows you the edges.
options.label: Confirm the paper fill
options.lose: A web change and a screens re-check.

options.how: The default is dropped, and the debt closes.
options.label: Overrule it: panels stay with no fill
options.lose: The list behind can show through an open panel.

ref: debt panel-paper-fill-unbuilt (overlay panels carry no paper fill); src/app.jsx panelWrap
title: Should the web's overlay panels get the paper fill? It's a default from 10-11 you never confirmed.
why: It is the standing default, and a screen check before it ships lets you see the edges.
